axes.name: loop_control_lifetimes
axes.rationale: The corrected MapB and all tested declaration/address spellings collapse to one OMF class. The target keeps two nested induction variables (outer step 0x40 in DI, inner step 1 in BX); compare equivalent for/while/do control lifetimes before moving to object context.

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
